mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points over one month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures indicate a broad-based demand contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month, SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% over one month indicates a supply shock, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines >0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation as measured by CPIAUCSL above 220 signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 220.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth exceeding 100,000 jobs in the prior month indicates a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate and high unemployment rate signals an economic recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 0.2% and UNRATE is above 9.0%, SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts exceeding 5% over one month indicates weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST declines >5% in 1 month.
